directChecks.method: Read-only Shapely 2.0.7 primitive-core/radius distances with circuit source graph net union; exact circles and rotated slot cores; no export/build/autorouter. Reproducible script rating_fab_margin-check.py and checked witnesses rating_fab_margin-direct-checks.json.

strengths: All 433 vias are conventional through barrels; 431 have generous 0.30 mm bore / 0.70 mm copper and 0.20 mm radial annulus. Only two need the denser 0.20 / 0.50 mm geometry.
All 93,528 via drill pairs and 9,526 via/PTH drill pairs pass their declared spacing with meaningful spare room (minima 0.500 and 0.860 mm).
The rectangular outline has no pad, via or trace copper-edge failure; minimum trace 0.650 mm, via 0.600 mm and imported PTH pad 1.210 mm.
All 1,639 nonzero planar wire segments checked against six NPTHs pass the declared 0.5 mm trace-to-bore rule; even the closest USB locator escape has 0.561 mm.

findings.explanation: An ordinary TEC_DAC via bore is only 0.015 mm from the U_DAC pin1 requested solder-mask opening, narrower than the inherited 0.025 mm minimum cited in final local-mask summary. These features are the same net. There is no foreign-net short here, but source tenting intent alone cannot establish a robust finished tent or prevent solder access to the bore. Its 0.35 mm annulus extends 0.185 mm into that requested pad opening in this nominal model.

evidence.formula: Mask left edge=-0.95-0.6/2-0.05=-1.30; bore right edge=-1.465+0.15=-1.315; gap=0.015 mm. Bore y=-21.62 lies within mask y range [-22.0,-20.8].

findings.explanation: Two additional same-net pad-adjacent ordinary vias retain only 0.025 mm nominal bore-to-requested-opening margin (R211/COLD_RAW and R206/PD_VALID_N). These are assembly-process concerns rather than copper-clearance failures; move their drill centers away from pad openings if route clearance permits.

The two named 0.20/0.50 mm vias reduce radial annulus to 0.15 mm. Their mutual drill spacing is 0.5333 mm, and copper spacing is 0.2333 mm, so this is not a drilling or copper-clearance failure. The SAFE_EN via is 0.05 mm from its same-net requested pin opening, so tenting/assembly margin remains tighter than the bulk 0.30/0.70 mm layout.

suspectedShortAssessment.assessment: No confirmed short in this fabrication drill/edge/mask scope. The measured narrow mask pairs are same-net copper. The user crop alone is insufficient to map the crossing confidently; parent reviewers covering crop registration and full foreign-net copper geometry must decide the pictured crossing.

topImprovements: Increase U_DAC.pin1 / TEC_DAC bore-to-requested-mask distance from 0.015 mm while preserving genuine electrical endpoint contact; optimize R211 and R206 adjacent-via positions too.
Keep the two smaller via classes explicit and narrowly owned; use ordinary 0.30/0.70 mm dimensions elsewhere.
Perform a separate finished-mask/profile/CPL/Gerber qualification before manufacturing; this is a qualification gap and not itself a static routing score penalty.
limitations: Full foreign-net copper-to-copper and full BREP topology are covered by other agents; this report independently scans drills, board edges, NPTH and nominal requested pad openings only.
The board is assessed as the exact frozen Source23 circuit; registry/cloud preview may use a different regenerated capture.
Distance checks are nominal source geometry and do not include registration, etch/drill tolerances, plating thickness or fabrication house acceptance.
A mask margin below 0.025 mm is not asserted as a declared DRC failure: the present report treats it as a process margin weakness and corrects the summary minimum.
